name: Shenzhou 11
about: Shenzhou 11 (2016-061A), a crewed vehicle (Shenzhou), launched 2016 Oct 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2016 Oct 17), held fixed
